import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { album } from "./album";
import { genre } from "./genre";
import { mediaType } from "./media_type";
import { invoiceLine } from "./invoice_line";
import { playlist } from "./playlist";

export const track = defineTable("track", {
    columns: {
        trackId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        name: col.varchar(200).notNull(),
        albumId: col.integer(),
        mediaTypeId: col.integer().notNull(),
        genreId: col.integer(),
        composer: col.varchar(220),
        milliseconds: col.integer().notNull(),
        bytes: col.integer(),
        unitPrice: col.numeric(10, 2).notNull()
    },
    relations: {
        album: rel.belongsTo(() => album, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        genre: rel.belongsTo(() => genre, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        mediaType: rel.belongsTo(() => mediaType, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        invoice_line: rel.hasMany(() => invoiceLine),
        playlist: rel.manyToMany(() => playlist)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
